description: DWD GeoServer WMS - NowCastMIX-Blitzdichte is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Deutscher Wetterdienst. This is the Web Map Server of DWD.:Flash density from NowCastMix methods in generic units; 5-minute update with flashes of the last 15minutes; nonlinear image from 0 to 3000 flashes per unit of time and 100qkm to the value range 0 to 127. Coverage: Deutscher Wetterdienst. The portal shows the English title as "DWD GeoServer WMS - NowCastMIX Flash Density" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Deutscher Wetterdienst. Its keywords include infoMapAccessService, GRIB, Rasterzelle (Gebietsraster), Beobachtungssystem. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2026-07-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
